page.layout: One page of running text, no margin notes. Running head centred at the top with the page number at the top right. Catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: Scientiarum[?] principia Chaldæi & Ægy-ptii tradiderunt, ea expolierunt Græci, & innumera, quæ illi ignorabant, ad-diderunt. Sed quid de Christianis, post Hipprachum & Ptolomæum dicendum, Lunæ cum Sole concordiam per octaë-terida venantibus? Id præstitit Dionysi-us Alexandr. Hippolytus verò per hec-cædecäeterida; quam hæc ad Rhombum? Nec vitium, qui hæc refert, Eusebius animadvertit. Tandem Anatolius pri-mus Christianorum ad enneadecaëterida confugit, quam amplexi sunt Concilii Nicæni Patres, & retexuit Eusebius. Credebant omnes Lunæ ad Solem hac Periodo. absolutissimam ἀποκατάστασιν[?] fieri; credidit hoc Beda, atque annorum mille spatio creditum est, donec erroris evidentia omnium oculos confi-gente tandem rem aliter se habere per-suasum est.

page.notes: The left edge of the first line is damaged; "Scientiarum" is doubtful. The Greek word "ἀποκατάστασιν" is partly smudged and the reading is uncertain. The catchword "bus" is at the bottom right. Long s is transcribed as s throughout. The printed spelling "qvam", "qvi" and "quidqvid" was normalised to u.
